card.name: Wartime and walled-city history narration
card.fires_on: Small words like "the", "to", "and" in war and Cold War history, right before a military or fortified-place term such as a wall, front, airfield or enemy. Also some word starts like "enc" (encamped) and "w" (walled).

modes.label: "the" before a front or barrier
modes.description: The word "the" after attack on, surrounded by, or get past, before a military target or wall.
modes.example: An attack on<< the>> western front against American and British forces
